svg.title: ShortenerTools production Azure architecture
svg.desc: Production deployment generated from the Aspire AppHost. One Azure Container Apps environment (Consumption) runs four single-replica apps: a public redirect Functions app bound to the custom short-link domain, a public Blazor admin with SocialPoster and Entra sign-in, a public API-key-protected management Functions app, and an internal scheduled-posts Functions app with four timers. They use an existing URL data storage account through managed identities, a new Functions host storage account, a new Azure Files share for SocialPoster data, workspace-based Application Insights, and a container registry. Microsoft Entra ID, Azure App Configuration, Azure OpenAI, social networks and Azure Communication Services email are prerequisites outside the deployment.
svg.text: Four single-replica workloads from one Aspire AppHost. Existing link data retained. Managed identity, isolated secrets, central telemetry.
EXTERNAL SERVICES · NOT PROVISIONED BY THE DEPLOYMENT
Azure Communication Services email (X intents, alerts)
No admin key, AI, App Config or social secrets
Publishes to socials · syncs creds to App Config
14 HTTP functions: links, stats, AI, Coffee
Default off · GitHub deploy enables all four
Uploaded Origin CA cert, referenced by name
DNS + first certificate: one-time operator step
Declared in the AppHost, so redeploys keep it
Attached by name (AsExisting) · never created or changed
3 Functions identities → Storage Table Data Contributor
Leases, timer status, queues · no link data
Share socialposter-data: SQLite DB + Data Protection keys
All 4 apps · OpenTelemetry · distinct cloud roles
Images pushed by aspire deploy · ACA Log Analytics
social posts + email · after timer cutover

Every app runs exactly one replica. Timers default to disabled; the production GitHub workflow enables all four after deploy. Staging uses a new data account, internal management API, no custom domain, AI or posting.
